Public PTemp, DL(2) As Long, DF(2), DS(2) As String * 16, DB(2) As Boolean
BeginProg
  DNP(20000,115200,1000)
  DNPVariable (DL(),2,30,1,0,0,0,0)
  DNPVariable (DL(),2,32,1,1,0,0,10)
  Scan (30,Sec,0,0)
    DNPUpdate (1,10)
  NextScan
EndProg

Public PTemp, DL(2) As Long, DF(2), DS(2) As String * 16, DB(2) As Boolean
BeginProg

  DNPVariable (DL(),2,32,1,1,0,0,10)
  DNPVariable (DL(),2,30,1,0,0,0,0)
  Scan (30,Sec,0,0)
    DNPUpdate (1,10)
  NextScan
EndProg
cases.expected_stdout:
t.CR6 -- Compile Failed!

line 4: Must assign group 30 before using group 32.
